# @stackline/redeyed {{PACKAGE_VERSION}}

Source-preserving JavaScript token transforms with immutable configs, safe property handling, and parser adapters.

Install: npm install @stackline/redeyed
Alias migration: npm install redeyed@npm:@stackline/redeyed
Documentation: https://alexandro.net/docs/vanilla/redeyed/
Source: https://github.com/alexandroit/stackline-redeyed
License: MIT; maintained @stackline/esprima runtime uses BSD-2-Clause

The default parser remains Esprima 4 through the exact historical-key alias to @stackline/esprima@1.0.0. Modern parsers are an explicit option and may expose different token labels.
